points.description: Core idea: insertion sort takes elements one at a time and inserts each into its correct position among the already sorted elements (the sorted part on its left).
points.partial_credit: 2 marks if only says it inserts elements into the right position, or builds a sorted portion, without the one-at-a-time / already-sorted-part idea, or with a minor error.

points.description: Detail: elements are processed from left to right, with the sorted elements being those to the left of the current element.
points.partial_credit: 0.5 if only the sorted-on-the-left or only the left-to-right idea is given vaguely.

rubric.notes: Full marks for stating that each element in turn is inserted into its correct place among the already sorted elements, in any wording; the left-to-right/left-sorted-part detail earns the last mark. Part marks for vague answers such as "it puts elements in the right place" or "it builds a sorted part". No marks for describing other sorts (e.g. repeatedly selecting the minimum, or swapping adjacent pairs across the whole array) or only giving running time.
